site_description: The Erstwählerforum is a political education event for the local elections on September 13th in Stade. All candidate parties have been invited. Student-moderated panel discussions on youth-relevant topics alternate with a political market where students can engage directly with politicians. The event is mandatory for grades 10+ of the four major schools in Stade and is organized by a student team.
